# Saturday API

> Nutrition intelligence for endurance athletes, as an API.

Saturday calculates personalized fuel, hydration, and electrolyte recommendations for endurance athletes from athlete profiles, activity parameters, and environmental conditions.

## Authentication

Authenticated API requests use a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Partner API keys use the `sk_test_` (sandbox) or `sk_live_` (production) prefix. Signup and public discovery endpoints do not require a key.

```
Authorization: Bearer $SATURDAY_API_KEY
```

Coaches use a separate surface with separate credentials: a `cp_live_` / `cp_test_` coach API key, or an OAuth2 token carrying coach scopes. Coach API keys are closed for now, and a coach's AI assistant reaches the coach surface only after the coach completes the training-setting step: https://docs.saturday.fit/guides/coach-api

## Core Endpoints

- POST /v1/nutrition/calculate: calculate a fuel/hydration/electrolyte prescription. Send athlete_id and every session input (intensity_level, thermal_stress_level, meal_before_min: over 180 is a fasted start, is_race) for exact numbers. A brick or triathlon is one call with activity_type brick or triathlon and legs, never one call per leg
- POST /v1/nutrition/calculate/batch: batch calculate for multiple scenarios
- POST /v1/nutrition/products/fit: size one catalog product against the athlete's prescription for a session; a brick or triathlon with legs is sized for the whole session and for each leg
- POST /v1/nutrition/products/compare: compare two products against the athlete's prescription for a session, per leg too for a brick or triathlon
- POST /v1/athletes: create an athlete profile
- GET /v1/athletes: list the partner's athletes
- GET /v1/athletes/{athlete_id}: one athlete, with computed subscription_status and profile_sharing (on | off | not_linked)
- GET /v1/athletes/{athlete_id}/fueling-profile: the athlete's Saturday app answers (sex, age, weight, fueling answers), only while they share them with you
- POST /v1/athletes/{athlete_id}/activities: create an activity (one sport, or a brick or triathlon with legs)
- POST /v1/athletes/{athlete_id}/activities/{activity_id}/calculate: calculate that activity's prescription
- POST /v1/athletes/{athlete_id}/activities/{activity_id}/prep: size the athlete's products against that activity's prescription; a brick or triathlon is prepped leg by leg, with one product list or a list per leg
- POST /v1/webhooks: register a webhook for real-time events

## Coach Endpoints

Requires the Pro Coach tier or above. Every athlete id is confined to the coach's roster.

- GET /v1/coach/roster: the roster with per-athlete needs-attention markers
- GET /v1/coach/roster/digest: flagged athletes only, most-flagged first
- GET /v1/coach/athletes/{athlete_uid}/fueling-rollup: in-window sessions plus the concern summary
- GET /v1/coach/athletes/{athlete_uid}/report: the AI fueling report, narrative plus structured data
- GET /v1/coach/athletes/{athlete_uid}/sessions/{activity_id}: one session's full projection plus the concern markers it crossed
- PUT /v1/coach/config/notification-rules: replace the alert rules at a scope
- POST /v1/coach/config/preset: apply hands_off, balanced, or hands_on at a scope
- POST /v1/coach/webhooks: register a coach webhook endpoint

## Safety

Every response includes safety metadata (confidence_score, warnings, max_safe_fluid_ml_per_hr, max_safe_sodium_mg_per_hr, not_instructions). Safety data is never gated behind subscription status. Bad hydration recommendations can cause exercise-associated hyponatremia, which kills athletes.

## Freemium Model

Subscribed athletes with complete profile and activity inputs get exact numbers. Incomplete inputs and free athletes get ranges. Check the range fields and precision object separately from tier. Safety data is complete either way.

## Athlete Profile Sharing

An athlete whose Saturday account is connected to your athlete record can share their Saturday app answers with your platform: one switch per partner platform in the Saturday app, or the hosted onboarding finish screen confirmed by email. Off until they turn it on, no expiry, never under 18. Saturday's calculations use the answers either way. Webhooks athlete.profile_sharing_changed and athlete.fueling_profile_updated say when to read again. Guide: https://docs.saturday.fit/guides/fueling-profile.

## Times

Every time a partner key receives is Unix seconds, over REST, webhooks and MCP; the Coach API answers in Unix milliseconds.

## Data Use

Every response carries the headers `X-Saturday-Data-License: display-only` and `X-Saturday-Data-Training: prohibited`. Response data is licensed for display to end users only. Training or fine-tuning models on it, aggregating it, reverse engineering the calculations, and redistributing it are all prohibited. See https://docs.saturday.fit/guides/data-policy.
